direct_ancestors.description: Level 1 Cell DIVE dataset from abdomen with marked sun related damage (by H&E evaluation) of a 69-year-old white male donor. Multiplexed immunofluorescence images were collected with the IN Cell 2200 as part of the NIH funded Human Biomolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP). There are 26 serial sections in this dataset.
